title: Inkling: Our Open-Weights Model
summary: Thinking Machines AI releases Inkling, their open-weights language model that provides public access to model weights for research and commercial use, following the trend of democratizing AI similar to Meta's LLaMA approach.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of accessible, openly-available powerful language models for researchers and developers who want to study, fine-tune, or deploy AI without restrictive licensing.
why_valuable: Increases AI accessibility and transparency by releasing model weights, enabling broader participation in AI research and development while reducing dependence on closed-source providers.
